## What changed?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include `bun run check` and relevant browser checks. Explain anything you could not verify.

## Screenshots

For interface changes, include before and after desktop and mobile views. Remove this section when it does not apply.

- [ ] The change is scoped to the stated problem.
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots reflect changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or temporary artifacts are included.
